valid_writer.lock: entropy_worker_new.lock, guarded by _THREADED_DECODER and a live pool

ordering.claim: valid and started are written by different code paths under different lock discipline in the shipped configuration
ordering.why: config.h sets _DELAYED_THREAD_START to 1, so the started writer does not take entropy_worker_new.lock, while the valid writer does
ordering.consequence: a reader comparing the two words under no lock cannot rely on a single consistent snapshot of the pair

inverse_branch_guards.note: spatial lowpass (index > 0), field-plus lowpass (index > 3) and spatial highpass (index == 3)

temporal_branch.reason: NDEBUG removes the assert, so the temporal inverse runs with no runtime readiness check at all

queue_drain.note: the admission decision is taken under the entropy worker lock, but the transform itself runs after Unlock() and is re-gated by an unlocked, non-atomic re-read of both flag words; the do/while condition at the loop tail repeats that unlocked read

debug_macro.reason: _DEBUG is an MSVC Debug-configuration macro; gcc and clang builds in this tree never define it, so `(1 && _DEBUG)` is 0

hollow_gate.note: seven runtime guards on the frame-output path that cannot detect an unreconstructed band

correct_gate_compiled_out.note: the only per-channel band-0 output check is behind #if DEBUG, which no configuration in this tree enables

dead_reader.reason: both call sites are in the #else branch of #if _THREADED_DECODER, which config.h enables
dead_reader.still_vacuous: it forwards to BANDS_ALL_VALID, the released macro

required_bit_matrix.status: upstream-supplied but unreachable in the shipped build

same_thread_claim.statement: the transform-queue drain loop and the inverse transform invocation are both inside EntropyWorkerThreadProc, so a consumer that blocks inside ReconstructWaveletBand removes one of the workers that could publish its input

worker_pool.note: a blocked worker reduces the drain capacity of a pool of at most 4

limitations: source reading only: no decode was executed by this pass
the per-topology matrix is re-derived from DecodedBandsValid, which the shipped build never calls
HALF 1080p BGRA on the pinned packet is the only measured condition in the referenced evidence; FULL was not exercised on either host
the temporal branch has no runtime check at all in a release build, so its race is characterised from source, not measured
no claim about other formats, resolutions or GOP structures
